notes.title: -New game update-
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after I announced a few weeks ago that there would be a discontiunation of more games to come things have finally settled down with work. I will have the abillity to release another game. I am unsure of when the game will be done or when the game will be be put on steam. I am aiming for sometime between April-June of 2019.  Here are a list of questions you might have and my answers

Q: Is this game the one you began a few months ago?
A: No it's a brand new game

Q: What type of game is it? 
A:  It's a arena/dungeon crawl based game!

Q: How many classes and playable characters will there be?
A: 10! Yes 10 classes you can play as 4 at a time, but in battle you will be able to change out in battle. 

Q: Is there a story if it's a dungeon crawl based game?
A: Not really, this is more or less a game about just brawling with monsters, getting gold, valuable items, and gear!

Q: Can we expect there to be some sort of game in progress (beta) phase on steam?
A: Yes, I plan to soft release the game to steam to gather feed back.

Q: Is this game going to be free to play?
A: YES! SO MUCH YES! FOR SURE 100% YES! This game will be free to play!!!! I feel like as there is a lot of indie/rpg maker games that charge for money those that do are seasoned vetrans of indie/rpg maker making. I am still new to all of this so I won't be charging, also I can understand that money can be an issue for some people so I will make it free to play!

Q: Do we buy gear in this game?
A: Yes you can! But gear will also drop. There will be different tier sets of gear that will make you stronger!

Q: Will the classes require to be swapped out every battle?
A: Nope, classes will be diverse so they will be good/bad in some battles depends on play style as well!

For anymore questions please post them down below I hope to bring this game to you soon!

notes.title: An update on 2nd game devlopment
notes.content:
Hello I am here to provide a update on the 2nd game that is currently in devlopment. Where do I being?

Lets start with what has me excited about this new game.
There is so much back story, lore, and new features in this game that I am conifdent you all will love. Although production was a little slow due to college semester finishing up I will be spending a lot more time on the game.

So what can I expect from this 2nd game?
Simply I have taken some aspects and concepts from the first game and mixed them into the 2nd game making the game story driven with lots of adventure, main quests, side quests, exploration, item crafting, and so much more.

When can we expect the game to come out?
At this exact moment a release date is impossible to tell because of where I am at devlopment and really want this game to be a big step up that drawns people in and gets them to say this is a game I love and always will becuase when I look at my games I grew up playing that I loved like Legia 2, Chrono Cross, and Legend of Dragoon and I can always say I will never not enjoy this game.

Will production take a while? Yes most likely with this game I want to take a massive leap with story, design, and content that gives people a experience they deserve.

As always I will provide updates when possible but because the game is still early in production stages this is very hard.

As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto and hoping to build a experience that you will love in the 2nd game.

notes.content:

Yesterday I announced Patch 1.2 but I will now be fusing Patch 1.2 into the DLC Patch which will be the next patch that comes out. My goal is to have the DLC done by April 25th hoping everything goes well it could come out even sooner.

As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now live
notes.content:
Hello all,
As promised Patch 1.1 is now here and live
Lets get into whats new in 1.1!

1.Charecter Bios/profiles!: You can now learn all about each playable charecter and their life before coming to Rujino. To do so go to the menu, then go to
status and click on Profile (At the bottom)! 
2.My personal favorite thing that has come to patch 1.1 and the game in general! Statistics! Who doesn't love stats!
To acess the stasitics go to menu then go to status and click on statistics and they will show the following stats 
-Battles iniated
-Kills and Kills per battle
-Deaths and Deaths per battle
-Assists and Assists per battle
-Damage dealt
-Damage taken
-Healing preformed
-Healing recieved 
!!!!
3. General stats! More stats! to acess general stats for each charcter like the Stats and profiles go to the menu and click on 
status and go to general stats! In this tab you can find the following information
-level
-Max HP
-Max MP
-Attack
-Defense
-M. Attack
-M. Defense
-Agillity 
-Luck
-Current XP
-To next level XP
-Total XP for next lvl
4.This is a cool new added feature! The items tab in menu has a new interface and so do all shops through the game!
5.That thing in the top right? YES! 
You can now always see your quest and quest objective of the one you are currently on in the top right of the screen!
That means you don't always need to re open your quest log! The quest you are currently on and it's objective show in the top right on the screen

This patch was my favorite to roll out. I love everything that has been added to the game this patch and hope you enjoy it as well

As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto!

notes.title: DLC Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone I thank you for being patient while I work on the DLC. 

There are some things I would like to talk about with the DLC that you might have questions about or anything and will be talking a little bit about the story line lets get started
 
Some possible questions you might have:

Q: Are the charecters from the main game going to be the ones in the DLC or will we see new charecters?

A: Yes all the charecters you have fallen in love with will be featured in the DLC

Q: Is Trist getting a visual update?

A: Yes I plan on releasing a visual update of Trist in the next few days.

Q: Will the quest tracker be used in the DLC?

A: Yes the quest tracking system will remain in use, this way you can track quests with ease/

Q: Are there new spells?

A: As of right now I haven't put new spells in yet but they are planned, as far as how many I am unsure but I do plan on new spells/abillties for all of the charecters

Q: Will I get to keep the elven ancient spells that I learn right before I fight the boss who drops the statue of the bear?

A: No, sadly the anicent elven spells are a little over powered and this is something I want to avoid, however I do plan on giving each charecter a special abillity based on their background, so basically we are tweaking the spells of the elven ancestors and Liss and Viktor will get special abillities as well.

Q: Will we see any programs like the quest tracker. 

A: Yes I plan on making updates to things with some plugins to revamp the game in some ways

Q: How long will the DLC take to complete.

A: At this stage I am uncerntian of this and will have a better gauge of this when I get deeper into devlopment

Story line:

So where do I begin? At the start I guess

When you defeat Yuj you will be trasnported to a costal beach inside the inn there will be a inn keeper who I suggest you talk to. From there you will board a boat to Sakio where you will start off in a sea port town and get a quest from a retired Sakio guard from there ... the crazniess begins. 

You will face a great variety of bosses and new monsters. The quest will take you from Northren Sakio all the way south where the demon army that is currently on the door step of Sakio Castle in South Sakio. It's something you will have to play for you'r self to see it's very hard to explain all of it with out ruining it.

This is all I have for right now to share I will keep you all updated.

As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto.

notes.title: DLC Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone I apologize for no updates recently I have been back at college and have been away for a bit due to college. I have been working on the DLC update and can share some things with you which I hope you will like,
If there is something you wold like to see added to this DLC or adjusted feel free to leave a comment!

So whats been done in the DLC update so far? 

1. The story: the story line for the DLC has been progressing in devolpment and I think this will be a fun story line all I can say is this...get ready for some tough bosses 

2. Maps/Buildings/Interiors: These are all going to be vital to me in this expansion because when the game released they were very lacking so whats new is the overworld is very different from the main story line and I like this because the idea of just roaming a snow map or grass map to me is not only confusing but is not visually attractive compared to the new overworld I will be using.

3. Spells: As of right now there are no current new spells or abillities added in  yet and aim to put these in last

4. Playable charecters: This is something that I have been debating for a month or two now and currently the DLC will include the same charecters from the main story line....BUT!
I am open to the idea of new charecters that allow for new classes and spells/abillities Ideally the planned new classes would be Paladin: Tank,dps,some healing. Rouge: High dmg class Hunter: dmg with some elemental abillities such as fire arrow and so on. Cleric: basically a priest. Mage: there is already a mage but still want to keep this concept. The other concept is  something similar to warlock class....

so... What classes will we be seeing? 

Like I said the charcters and classes are all up in the air right now because I am open to the idea of new characters and classes even though DLC story line progression has been started with the original characters so I would like all of you to give input on If you want new charecters for the DLC and if so what classes.

5. States/Statuses: The mainly story line had absence of things like posion, confusion, and so on and these are ideas i am thinking about incorperating. 

When will the DLC be done?

Due to college classes and that I am trying out for my colleges soccer team I am very busy right now but will work on this each day for what I can, I aim to release the DLC before August.

I will post more updates about DLC when I can.

As always: 
Thank you for your patronage.

notes.title: Patch 0.2 Now Live
notes.content:
Hello everyone I apologize for the late update there have been fixes and some changes to the game.

The first thing is that in the quest journal text would be cut off making it hard to figure out what do to. Well that is fixed and you should be fully able to see the text

We also made some changes to specific monsters and their color altough a small change I felt that giving some of the charecters a fresh look would be a good idea

There are some updates to the first boss, the dragon. The dragons play style in combat has been revamped the dragon now uses a spell called dragons breath with this the dragon deals fire damage to all of your party members. This was needed because the boss seemed very easy and I will be looking over the other bosses and looking into making any changes that are needed. Not only is the dragon updated but castle Io has recieved a physical updated and is no longer a bland interior and I will be revamping all other boss layers that could use a fresher look. 

These changes are currently live in the patch and I am going to be looking into more ways I can improve the game!

As always thank you for playing Journey to Luonto! We are currently on the front page of new and trending RPG Maker Games and I thank all who have downloaded and played the game.

notes.title: Journey to Luonto Patch 0.1 Now Live
notes.content:
Hello everyone I took notes of your suggestions and went back and changed quite a bit of stuff some major changes include updated interriors to village building and other building since a lot of places lacked it. I am also pleased to announce the introduction of Quest Log/Journal you will now be able to obtain,track, follow, and complete quests the Quest Log is located in the Menu screen. There are also some smaller changes made like adding new spells the spell Leaf Barrage has been added to Liss's spell book and will be unlocked around level 16. There are other things I am looking at including into the game. As always I thank you all for playing my first ever game. We hit over 500 downloads and I am thankful for that and even more thankful for all who have played it. I hope you enjoy the new version of the game with it's updates and hope all of those who have already played the game try out the new update. As always thank you.


Daniel

notes.title: Journey to Luonto patch 0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone this is Daniel the maker of journey to Luonto with this being my first ever game I have made well I am going to be making a few updates to the game for a better player experience I am currently testing out a program that is a quest log where you can receive track follow and complete quest this add-on is still being tested. I am aware of a few bugs with you requiring to hit enter when ever you go to a ship in a port town well I believe I have a solution for it and will be rolling it into the 0.1 patch. As for the other update needed I am aware of the bug with the king in castle io not appearing after the dragon this is a simple fix and I will be making these changed tonight and hope to put out the new live build version. If you are experiencing any other issues let me know as far as the occasional 2-4 second lag I unfortunately can't do much about that since I an using RPG maker for the game so if you are looking to download the game you can play the updated version soon. Because this my first steam game I think to play the updated version you have to uninstall and re install if you already have it but you can copy paste your saved game data from current play through into the new games folder when you download it.


Update 12/2 10:30 all changes that needed to be changed are fixed but I will be re camping the interiors of buildings.... and adding a quest log/ quest tracker due to having a job I am unable to finish the full patch update tonight I will be working on finishing the patch no later than Monday thank you for your patience
